I am a senior data scientist at [4kst](https://4kst.com/), a deep tech startup. I finished my bachelor's degree in statistics in 2015, and my master's in statistics in 2021. Between these two degrees, I ran my own statistical consultancy company [GP Soluções em Estatística](https://gpestatistica.netlify.app/) impacting over 200 researchers. My main published papers are from [bachelor's degree]()

I have a strong background in R, and since 2021 I program in Python almost everyday.

### Content Published

+ You can find my TCC [here](TCC_Guilherme_Isadora_link_azul.pdf) and the respective [article](https://soche.cl/chjs/volumes/10/ChJS-10-02-03.pdf);

+ From my [master thesis](Master_Thesis.pdf), I published two papers: [1](https://ajs.or.at/index.php/ajs/article/view/1574) and [2](https://www.tandfonline.com/doi/abs/10.1080/00949655.2023.2184474).
